name: A deep-sea probe
what: A sensor left on the ocean floor for ten years: no repair, no sunlight, only the energy it carried down. It must bear faults and the cold three times better than today's computer, keep its readings exact, and spend little.
ai: Written by Claude while building #481, as an example of the form: the weights and musts were tried against the engine until purposeWhy found it neither too easy nor too hard.
words: An example of a purpose: nothing built or kept so far bears a decade alone on the sea floor well enough.
